description: This PHP file defines an abstract class 'loc_xml' that extends 'source'. It provides a method '__parse' for reading and parsing XML files, specifically loading the contents of a given file into a SimpleXML object after disabling external entity loading for security.

classes.name: loc_xml
classes.description: An abstract class for XML data sources that provides a method to parse XML files into SimpleXML objects.

methods.name: __parse
methods.description: Reads the contents of a specified file and loads it as a SimpleXML object after disabling external entity loading for security.
